reason: I already invest monthly in a broker app that costs me nothing, and with under $20k in there any monthly fee eats a real chunk of my returns. Paying a subscription for a cartoon pet to do what I already do on my commute doesn't add up for me.
objection: It's another subscription with no price yet, on top of whatever the broker partner charges, and a Tamagotchi just feels unserious when it's my actual money.
would_change_my_mind: If it were free or a flat few bucks a year with no extra trading fees, and the demo showed it actually beating my plain index fund habit after costs.
